llm.summary: This is a coherent real-estate skill kit with local calculators and templates; the main caution is to narrow generated triggers and handle customer/referral records with explicit consent.

dimensions.detail: Executable code is limited to local Python calculators, a local template renderer, a mock adapter, and the shell installer. Static inspection found no network calls, credential/session-store access, background workers, cron/system service setup, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The installer is user-invoked and copies a specified rendered skill directory into a detected agent skills directory, then writes a local .sha256 checksum. This changes the agent skill set, but the behavior is disclosed and does not fetch remote code or install packages.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some top-level, example, and template activation phrases are broad, but they are aligned with real-estate skill selection, calculation, buyer advice, or sales workflows. The templates also include boundaries, compliance checks, data-availability checks, and refusal language for unsafe real-estate practices.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is local and purpose-aligned: generated output files, installed skill copies, .sha256 records, and optional calculator templates under my_templates. CRM/referral templates discuss customer records and official registration workflows, so deployments should add explicit notice and consent before recording personal or reward-attribution data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts match the stated purpose: a real-estate AI skill kit with local calculation tools, brand skill templates, examples, and a mock adapter. I found no unrelated data access, exfiltration, destructive behavior, or deceptive instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing or publishing a generated skill, review and narrow the trigger keywords for the exact city, project, role, and user intent. If enabling CRM, attribution, or referral modules, make sure users are told what personal data will be recorded, where it will be stored, and how official registration or reward processing works.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The top-level SKILL.md activation is broad, but it describes real-estate skill installation, use, generation, or role-based selection for this kit rather than unrelated authority.
[SQP-1] expected: The developer sales example uses generic real-estate keywords; this should be narrowed in a production branded skill, but the file is an example config and the generated archetype discloses that it represents the project seller.
[SQP-1] expected: The Kunming buyer example uses broad city and housing terms; the consumer template includes search thresholds, excluded domains, and clarification behavior, so this is a tuning issue rather than hidden behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The calc-toolkit activation covers real-estate calculation requests. The bundled scripts are local calculators with explicit parameters and policy-source output, not autonomous financial decision tools.
[SQP-1] expected: The consumer-buy archetype uses a configurable trigger placeholder, but it also requires user intent checks before data lookup and includes privacy, data accuracy, and conversion-timing limits.
[SQP-1] expected: The developer-sales archetype trigger depends on configured keywords. The sales role is disclosed and the instructions require truthful pricing, no unsupported promises, and no premature lead capture.
[SQP-1] expected: The loan-calc module can trigger on common monthly-payment or tax questions, but it requires parameters to be gathered, assumptions to be labeled, and bank/tax authority caveats to be shown.
[SQP-2] expected: Referral registration is aligned with the referral-growth module, but production use should add an explicit user-facing notice and confirmation before recording referrer relationships or reward data.
